summary: This excerpt from Book 14 (part 30) is a chat-log style fiction passage in which members of an online group react to Shad having obtained a lawyer for a legal case involving the "Minneapolis Nine." The group discusses starting a defense fund, and Gargle shares a link to a "Solidarity Committee for the Minneapolis Nine" site, whose owner Gargle traced via a Whois search. Shad, hesitating, reflects on feeling closer to the Group than to family members Wilson and Monica, and recalls how members helped one another, including buying a train ticket for freddieb and delivering pizza to Wrath of Cohen during chemo. Gargle then apologizes to Shad.
one_line: In a fiction excerpt, an online activist group rallies around Shad's legal case, raising a defense fund and reflecting on their bond as family.
key_facts: Shad reports having got a lawyer, and the group reacts with cheers from ferret, callmecheese, and others.
DoDec says the lawyer's legal team is large and suggests starting a defense fund because filing fees add up fast.
Kadabra offers to start a PayPal fund and asks members to DM their details.
Gargle found a site for "The Solidarity Committee for the Minneapolis Nine" that resembles sites used by other local activist groups.
Gargle's Whois search showed the site owner's identity was public, including address and phone number.
Gargle describes the site owner as a kid who became a full-time organizer building websites and running social media campaigns for progressive causes in the Twin Cities.
Shad says they have no connection to the Solidarity Committee and did not know them.
Shad admits feeling closer to the Group than to Wilson and Monica in some ways, though the bond is different from family.
The Group shared inside jokes and helped members with code, hardware, and a mesh network after a typhoon.
The Group bought a train ticket so freddieb could attend a hackathon in London, since he could not afford it.
When Wrath of Cohen was undergoing chemo and feeling down, the Group had his favorite pizza delivered to his hotel room.
Shad had kept parts of their life private even from the Group, which now seems weird to them.
Gargle, who posted the link, apologizes to Shad for the link, saying it was probably not even the same thing.
